mechanics.reason: Generated city row grants the HoMM3 Castle wood and ore daily income.
Generated city row grants +3 weekly growth to the Griffin line.

Building pass 2026-11-22: own row Build_Stables (heroBonusBanks carrier, no native bonus). Homm3CastleStablesRuntime gives each visiting hero the vanilla stable_buff (+20% movement points, until the end of the week) once per week, as the HoMM3 Stables does. The Cavalier upgrade link is not part of the building. The Bank slot is a plain economy Bank again.

Building pass 2026-11-22: new banks carrier Build_Mother_Nature; the hero defending this city in a siege gets +2 Morale through the runtime agent's Homm3TownSiegeDefenseRuntime, the HoMM3 effect. A heroless garrison gets nothing (no hero to carry the stat).

Building pass 2026-11-22: Olden Era has no ships, so the HoMM3 Lighthouse (+ship movement, needs Shipyard) cannot exist. Its land-safe equivalent is the Signal Beacon (Build_Mycelium_Roots): every hero of a side owning a Castle city with it keeps a +10% movement points buff (Homm3CastleSignalBeaconRuntime, refreshed at each day start). The old +1-of-each-resource grail substitute is no longer this mechanic.

Building pass 2026-11-22: the grail keeps its current extras (HumanGraal gold + 5 resources, +100% city growth; owner answer 3) and adds the HoMM3 +2 Morale for all the owner's heroes as a native graal side heroStat.
